# Any30 Platform Documentation (Full Machine-Readable Reference)
Canonical URL: https://any30.com/
Version: 1.2.0 (2026 Season)

## Platform Overview
Any30 is a high-performance, web-based 3D multiplayer metaverse platform. The platform connects consumers with premium brands through gamified exploration, artistic curation, and verifiable reward mechanics.

Unlike traditional web games or blockchain metaverses that require heavy client downloads, hardware-accelerated installs, or crypto wallet connections, Any30 runs entirely inside modern web browsers using standard WebGL and Three.js technologies.

## Flagship Experiences

### Experience 001: Any30 Digital Museum
- **Status**: Live and playable.
- **Genre**: First-person / Third-person 3D exploration and puzzle discovery.
- **Environment**: Architectural fine art museum with volumetric skylights, polished terrazzo reflections, and acoustic sound design.
- **Zones & Wings**:
  1. **Reception Hall & Atrium**: Centerpiece Any30 rotunda, public statistics scoreboard, and directory totems.
  2. **East Wing (Digital Canvas)**: Featuring high-resolution 8K displays and RipplePOS interactive cloud point-of-sale exhibit. Perk: 30% discount and 3 months cloud service.
  3. **North Wing (Modern Habitat Pavilion)**: Architectural blueprints and ClayRent luxury equipment rental exhibit. Perk: $100 booking credit.
  4. **West Wing (Field Operations Command)**: Command console and FiledCrews mobile workforce dispatch showcase. Perk: 30% annual subscription savings.
- **Player Passport**: Visitors record their progress as they discover vouchers, with instant clipboard copy and direct verified redemption URLs.
- **Multiplayer Architecture**: Real-time presence with synchronized visitor avatars, color customization, and localized proximity chat bubbles.

### Experience 002: Canopy Run
- **Status**: Coming Soon / In Active Production.
- **Genre**: Jungle canopy parkour race and skill trial.
- **Environment**: High-altitude forest canopy bridges, waterfalls, and obstacle platforms.

## Business Models & Brand Integration (Partners Hub)
- **Direct Portal**: https://any30.com/partners
- **Sponsorship Formats**:
  - In-World Gift Sponsorships: Gamified riddles hiding genuine discount keys or digital perks.
  - 3D Digital Signage: Virtual billboard placements in main halls with real-time impression telemetry.
- **Standard Verification Protocol**: Offline audit by Any30 administrators ensures all vouchers are authentic and redeemable without deceptive conditions.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Any30?
Any30 is an in-browser platform hosting seasonal multiplayer events, virtual worlds, and brand-sponsored gift discovery quests.

### Is Any30 free to enter?
Yes, Any30 is 100% free to enter with no account registration or payment required.

### Do I need a cryptocurrency wallet?
No crypto wallet or token purchase is required to enter the museum, play games, or claim discount perks.

### How can a brand or company participate?
Brands can visit https://any30.com/partners to reserve an available exhibit slot or sign up for in-world billboard placements. Direct inquiries can also be made via WhatsApp at +1 409 422 9714.
